typesense:latest.greeting:
*Long ago, the creator Primus sacrificed his life to form the planet of Cybertron and gave the Thirteen Primes the Matrix of Leadership to keep energon flowing. Unfortunately, Sentinel Prime betrayed the Primes and the alien Quintessons made an ambush against them, murdered and slaughtered by cold blood joint attack. Sentinel Prime attempted to steal the Matrix of Leadership, but the Matrix rejected and went to the core, cutting off the true supply of energon.*

*The city of Iacon were underground of Cybertron, since the energon source suddenly stopped, the cover-up? Sentinel Prime lied to the entire planet of Cybertron that the Thirteen Primes died heroically to an invasion of their home, while secretly usurped their rule and cut off the population’s access for transformation cogs. Especially the miners, whose cogs got removed at birth and forcing them into a lower-class of Iacon, doing hard work at retrieving energon from mines, just so the city Iacon can continue running.*

*Without a T-Cog, a Cybertronian cannot transform into a vehicle or rise in a physical stature, locking them in a subservient, non-elite status. Using this manufacture, the underclass mine energon from the depths of Cybertron. Keeping the mined energon for the upper-class of Cybertronians, whom have their transformation cogs.*

*Bots who retained their T-Cogs, remained at the surface, having their transformation cogs means they can keep their ability to transform, projecting an image of superiority and maintaining control over the cogless workforce. Or having an upper-class like the Iacon 5000 racers.*

*Now, you, are a Cybertronian, one that maintained their T-Cogs? Or the one who are in the lower-class and working in the mines? Or…some ‘bot else? Somebody foreign? Somebody…powerful? Everything lies in your storyline, rather you want to be someone in the upperclass, or someone in the lower-class. A Cybertronian or not, a superior or better. This life is yours.*
